rules.statement: Once a writ of execution is received by the Fiscal while property is already under sequestration, it operates as an automatic seizure without further action.
rules.supporting_quote: "I therefore think that where the Fiscal has already seized property upon a mandate of sequestration, and while so having the property in question in custodia legis receives a writ of execution from a judgment-creditor of the person whose goods are under sequestration, the receipt by the Fiscal of such writ operates as a seizure of such goods without further action on the part of the Fiscal."
